race.comment: Hard to go past REGAL AMBITION (1) who comes through clearly the best form lines. She was awesome making a sustained run to win the Listed Jim Moloney two back which saw her start a firm favourite in the G1 Thousand Guineas. It was very hard to make ground that day so her effort to grab third was strong and getting to Flemington looks a huge positive. PIN UP SHEILA (4) is a progressive filly who hit the line strongly in the G3 Reginald Allen in Sydney last time out. Respecting that form with J-Mac booked. AFFARI (3) finally broke the maiden last time and did so dominantly. Prior to that she'd been beaten under a length by Barracks and that form has stood up fairly well in Melbourne. BLUE DREAM (12) was a real 'believe your eyes' win on debut at Kyneton, coming from a mile back to score. Looks talented and can progress. I AM ARIA (2) is racing well and should be thereabouts again.
